newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romanian Defence Minister Victor Babiuc signed military cooperation accord with his Greek counterpart Akis Tsohatzopoulos.

Romania and Greece are vital elements of the region's stability which is why NATO should open to countries like Romania, Tsohatzopoulos said. He said his country fully supported Romania in its bid to join the Western defence alliance.
* Romania switches to summer time on Saturday, March 29, when the clock goes forward one hour at local midnight. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
